platforms.name: KEXP Music Department Digital Airplay Submission Email Route
platforms.country: United States / global eclectic independent radio and music-discovery audience
platforms.feeAmount: KEXP states that airplay cannot be purchased. The official digital email route has no stated submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KEXP accepts digital releases at md@kexp.org, but final delivery requires a human to select a suitable MarcsMusic release, verify ownership and release status, prepare streaming and WAV download links without attachments, supply the requested credits, focus tracks, lyric sheet, bio and clean edits where required, approve all personal data and send the email. KEXP receives high submission volume, cannot guarantee spins or a reply, and editorial review must not be automated.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from KEXP official contact, submission-guidelines and homepage pages. The official contact page specifically directs music for rotation consideration to Music Director Chris Sanley and the Music Department at md@kexp.org. The guidelines require streaming and WAV download links with no attachments, artist names and pronouns, release title and label where applicable, pronunciation guidance, focus tracks, release dates, clean versions for FCC-restricted content, lyrics, credits, a bio or one-sheet and relevant Pacific Northwest or Bay Area dates. KEXP prefers digital submissions and says not to send physical music. The station explicitly states that spins cannot be guaranteed or purchased. Current official programming, new-music reviews, podcasts and public sessions scheduled for July 2026 confirm activity. The address has valid syntax, matches the official domain and is purpose-specific. No contact was guessed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed. No email, music, file, link, metadata or personal data was prepared or sent.

platforms.name: KUTX Music Director On-Air Rotation Submission Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Austin-based public radio with global new-music and electronic specialty programming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, account, login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is stated for KUTX on-air rotation consideration. Paid event sponsorship is a separate route and is not used for editorial music submission.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KUTX accepts mastered new or upcoming releases through music@kutx.org, but a human must confirm track and programme fit, verify rights and release status, prepare an approved streaming link and downloadable WAV link without MP3 attachments, provide the required bio, location, release notes and clean radio edit where necessary, select the top track when sending multiple songs, approve the pitch and personal data, and send the email manually. Editorial consideration and any specialist-show outreach cannot be automated.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-13 from KUTX official Submit Your Music page and homepage. KUTX directs on-air rotation submissions to Music Director Rick McNulty at music@kutx.org with the subject Music Submission – [Artist Name]. Required material includes a streaming link, a downloadable WAV link preferably through Dropbox or Google Drive, a concise bio, location, release notes, tour information and collaborations; MP3 attachments are prohibited. Tracks must be final masters, preferably new or upcoming, and clean for FCC compliance. Austin or Texas artists may flag locality, but the route is not stated as local-only. The page lists separate specialty programmes, including Soundfounder for electronic and experimental music, while the current homepage shows July 2026 episodes featuring electronic and beat music from Austin and around the world, Latin music, hip-hop and new releases. The core submission address has valid syntax, matches the official domain and is purpose-specific. Event forms, invitations, sponsorship and specialist-host routes were not repurposed or entered. No contact was guessed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed. No email, music, file, link, metadata or personal data was prepared or sent.
